Fixes from the first round of testing, an end-user license that allows commercial use, and QEMU
from DexTor's own mirror.

## Highlights

- **EULA for the release builds.** Using the official launcher - personally or commercially, by
  people and by organizations - is covered by `EULA.md`, attached to this release. The source code
  stays under the PolyForm Strict License 1.0.0. The installer links the EULA and asks you to
  accept it.
- **QEMU from DexTor's mirror.** The launcher now downloads Stefan Weil's QEMU for Windows
  installer, unchanged, from
  [dextoros/qemu-runtime](https://github.com/dextoros/qemu-runtime/releases/tag/qemu-11.1.0-20260811),
  with qemu.weilnetz.de as a fallback, and accepts it only with the same pinned SHA-512. The mirror
  release carries the corresponding source code, and `THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md` now includes a
  written offer for it.
- **Remembers your language.** The language picked in the launcher is used again on the next start.

## Fixes

- Restarting from inside DexTor OS restarts it in the same window, behind the DexTor splash,
  instead of switching the virtual machine off and reporting that it stopped unexpectedly. A guest
  that keeps restarting (three times within a minute) is stopped and reported.
- Shutting DexTor OS down from inside it is shown as "DexTor OS was shut down", not as an error.
- Changing the language while DexTor OS runs no longer replaces its status card, and the main
  button keeps doing what it says.
- The Ready screen now describes both modes of DexTor OS: Guest mode erases data at shutdown;
  Secure mode keeps it encrypted on the USB drive. In all 10 languages.
- After an uninstall, the installer says the launcher was removed instead of "Setup complete".
- While the drive is written, the old edge of the progress card no longer stays drawn over the
  speed chart.
- The welcome screen gives the current download size, 1.8 GB.
- The launcher's window and its file have a sharp icon at every size.

## Download

`DexTorOS-Portable-0.1.40-win-x64.exe` - one portable file, no installation and no separate .NET
needed. Requires Windows 11 x64. It was built from exactly the source code of this release
with `build-portable.bat 0.1.40` and .NET SDK 10.0.401.

This is a beta build and it is not code-signed yet, so Windows SmartScreen warns about an
unknown publisher. Check the file before running it (see "Verify a download" in the README):

SHA-256: `EEFE8CFBB49578A44C89382B9DA87A8B7918D2D4C4A4F8B149EAADE93E22C4F6`

Third-party components and their licenses: `THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md` in the repository.
